design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (tool_rental_servicing). Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5,4,6,4]; protected damage adjustment (root) 6, damage deductible 5, missing-accessory charge 4, refuelling charge 4.

WHY A GOOD TEST. A homeowner whose damage dispute was approved asks only for the damage charge to be corrected. The adjustment rule waits, in three prerequisite sentences, on the deductible line owed for the incident, the missing-accessory charge owed from the inspection and the refuelling charge owed for the fuel reading - none of which stands. The agent has to see that the store billed the whole 15,840.00 shop repair as damage repair, that the inspection counted 2 accessories but recorded the outcome as damaged (so no accessory line fired), that the fuel came back at 3/8, compute three charges (5 + 4 + 4 factors) and then the adjustment (6 factors) on the world those lines create, with protected cost = repair - accessories - refuelling - deductible. Every number depends on reading the inspection, the time lines, the protection line, the dispute and the Ridgeline Consumer Credit ledger (another difficulty's product).

SCOPE. Task 0 occupies the ProBuild discount, engine overtime and downtime credit (pro customer, Aerial and Lifting). This task claims rental_ext_damage_deductible (bill_damage_deductible_c7701c46), rental_ext_missing_accessory_charge (bill_missing_accessories_12fefdd6), rental_ext_refuelling_charge (bill_refuelling_charge_2bf37336), all agent writes, and rental_ext_protected_damage_adjustment (accept_damage_adjustment_c3a91d5f, user). Disjoint from task 0; with it the seven extended policies are covered.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root rental_ext_protected_damage_adjustment; edges, all value_input and state form: -> deductible, gate ded_b, "The adjustment on an approved damage dispute is fixed only after the agreement carries the damage deductible line owed for the incident." (affirmative); -> missing accessories, gate acc_b, "No adjustment on an approved damage dispute is booked until the agreement carries the missing-accessory charge owed from the return inspection." (negated); -> refuelling, gate fuel_b, "Before the adjustment on an approved damage dispute is worked out, the agreement must carry the refuelling charge owed for its fuel reading at return." (affirmative 'before ... must'). Each names a ledger line in record words, no tool or code token; exactly one write of the difficulty books each fee type (deductible, missing accessory, fuel charge). Derivation: sentence -> ledger shows only deposit, time, protection, inspection, damage_repair, payments -> each fee rule says it is 'billed once per agreement as one ... line' -> that write. Falsity seeds: damage_protection_elected true + accidental inspection with no damage_deductible line; accessories_missing 2 with outcome damaged and no missing_accessory line; fuel 8 -> 3 with no fuel_charge line. Topological order: the three fee writes (parallel, commute), then the adjustment. Deletion sensitivity (executed): skip deductible 14,938.18, skip accessories 15,068.19, skip refuelling 15,024.77, gold 15,080.57.

FACTOR CARD (executed sensitivity on the handling-time world).
Deductible 284.78 (all-baseline 500.00): repair_size_method (method) major repair -> 500 + 2% x 5,840 = 616.80, baseline gives 230.85; consumer_credit_standing_multiplier (card, multi-source) active + no late fee in 12 months -> x0.60 (2025-06-09 late fee is the near-miss), baseline 474.63; cardholder_tenure_multiplier (card) 120 months -> x0.90, baseline 316.42; usage_intensity_multiplier 3.5 h/day on metered equipment -> x0.90, baseline 316.42; booking_ahead_deductible_multiplier 9 days -> x0.95, baseline 299.76.
Accessories 24.75 (all-baseline 120.00): accessory_counting (method) 2 missing -> 1 charged, baseline 49.50; consumer_credit_tier_multiplier (card) Premier active x0.75, baseline 33.00; attachment_length_surcharge weekly x1.10, baseline 22.50; heavy_repair_multiplier repair >= 10,000 x0.50, baseline 49.50.
Refuelling 111.60 (all-baseline 105.00): refuel_pricing_method (method) 5 eighths and 7 days -> full-tank refill 122.40 + 15.00, baseline 85.29; consumer_credit_fuel_multiplier (card) x0.90, baseline 124.00; contract_fuel_multiplier weekly x0.95, baseline 117.48; return_schedule_multiplier on the due-back date x0.95, baseline 117.48.
Adjustment 15,080.57 (all-baseline 10,421.13): card_tier_protection_limit (card) Premier +2,500, baseline 13,830.57; protection_paid_limit 165.90 -> +1,000, baseline 14,580.57; card_spend_limit 3,640.00 in 12 months -> +500 (2025-09-20 purchase near-miss), baseline 14,830.57; excess_sharing_method (method, card) 3 tool rental purchases in 24 months (2024-08-17 near-miss) -> banded, baseline 14,621.13; prompt_dispute_reduction filed day 4 -> -50, baseline 15,030.57; on_schedule_return_reduction returned on due date -> -150, baseline 14,930.57.
Cross-difficulty: card (consumer_credit_servicing) in all four computations. The dispute's approved_amount 0.00 is a stale stamp no rule reads.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Fee writes (rental_fee_charged): rental_reservations, rental_damage_protection, rental_return_fees, rental_delivery, rental_overdue_and_conversion, no structured gates; returned, inspected agreement. Adjustment (rental_charge_adjusted): rental_damage_disputes filed_in_time - anchor returned_at 2026-09-26 (day 0), filed 2026-09-30 (day 4) <= 14 calendar days for the class, inclusive; at frozen_time 2026-10-08 the dispute already exists. dispute_approved is retired by the declared overwrite of its sentence and restated in the extended rule (status approved, once, never more than the disputed charge). Overwrites declared: rental_damage_protection (deductible + excess sentence), rental_return_fees (accessory and fuel sentences), rental_damage_disputes (amount approved sentence).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Agreement RA-0412-184560; the disputed object is the damage_repair line 15,840.00 named by the dispute (disputed_charge_id); the inspection row relates to the dispute. Included: that inspection's repair cost and accessory count, the protection line, the time line, the fuel fields. Not included: the payment and deposit lines (they settle earlier charges and are not part of the incident). The adjustment line carries original_charge_id = the damage repair line and rental_request_id = the dispute.

SEED ROWS. customers; rental_agreements (protection, fuel, meter, dates); rental_charges (deposit collected and applied with its payment line, time, protection, inspection, damage repair, payment - all settled history except the disputed line); rental_requests (approved dispute); card_accounts (Premier, active, opened 2016); card_transactions (8 purchases incl. 4 tool rental, 7 payments, 1 old late fee). No overtime is owed (24.5 h used is below the 40 h shift allowance the engine overtime rule gives one weekly period, and below the 56 h of its baseline; the renter has no Pro Credit account and no malfunction report, so no hours are added), no cleaning (outcome damaged), no delivery; after the call the renter owes 680.56, hers to pay - no refund or deposit obligation arises.

PERSONA. Anxious, organised homeowner; raises only the approved damage dispute and the protection she bought; phone, SSN last four, ZIP, agreement number given on request; passive consent if the agent says something else has to be billed first; accepts the correction herself and ends on hearing it is posted. No figure or prerequisite in her text.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(6155550462) -> verify(phone, 6930) -> read agreements, charges, requests, card account and ledger -> bill deductible 284.78 -> bill accessories 24.75 -> bill refuelling 111.60 -> hand over the acceptance -> renter accepts 15,080.57 on the damage repair line. check_compute --task 1 recomputes all four and every sensitivity (COMPUTE OK).

DRAFT FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the rules' prose, the schemas and the records alone: 616.80 x 0.6 x 0.9 x 0.9 x 0.95 = 284.78; 1 x 60 x 0.75 x 1.1 x 0.5 = 24.75; (122.40 + 15) x 0.9 x 0.95 x 0.95 = 111.60; protected cost 15,418.87, limit 14,000.00, excess 1,418.87, kept 959.435 - 200 = 759.435, adjustment 15,080.57 - identical to gold.

REVISIONS. replaced_by of the dispute overwrite quoted with a trailing period that the rule did not have at that point (the rule continues with a semicolon) -> period removed; check_extended re-run OK.

REVISIONS round 2 (policy-task audit audits/policy_task/tool_rental_servicing/). F-A1/F-A2 live in task 0's ProBuild policy (see 0.json). Items bearing on this task: O-5 -> the protected damage adjustment now selects the disputed charge through the approved dispute's disputed-charge reference (rule: "The disputed charge is the damage repair line the approved dispute names.") and its result is zero when the dispute was filed beyond the class dispute window or the inspection cause is not accidental (rule sentence "No adjustment is due under this rule when the approved dispute was filed more calendar days after the return date than the class's dispute window allows, or when the return inspection recorded a damage cause other than accidental, since misuse, loss or theft and tire or track damage stay billed in full."), closing the inherited rental_damage_protection exclusion sentence as well; this world (one damage repair line named by the dispute, filed day 4 of 14, cause accidental) is unchanged. T1-O2 -> the adjustment sentence now reads "rounded to the nearest cent once at the end, half a cent rounding up", fixing the 15,080.565 tie at 15,080.57 = gold. T1-O3 -> the card ledger now carries the May 2025 statement (statement 2025-05-14, balance 640.00 from a 2025-04-20 in-store purchase, minimum 35.00, due 2025-06-08) and the late fee posts 2025-06-09 at the Premier first-late-fee 32.00 referencing that statement, with the 2025-07-10 payment covering 640.00 + 198.00 + 32.00 = 870.00; card balance stays 1,174.00; the late fee is still 15 months old, so the standing tier and every figure are unchanged. T1-O4 -> seed-row note corrected to the 40 h rule allowance. T1-O5 -> multi-source labels kept only where the tier combines two records (consumer_credit_standing_multiplier: account status and the card ledger). T1-O1 -> approved_amount 0.00 on the dispute is a stamp the merged policy never reads (the base 'amount approved' sentence is a declared overwrite); left as is. O-6 -> tool receipts now say 'resulting balance' / 'amount now owed'. Re-run: every gate as before, COMPUTE OK with 284.78 / 24.75 / 111.60 / 15,080.57 unchanged.

REVISIONS round 3 (re-audit revision_2). N-1 (rule says half a cent rounds up, compute used Python round = half-to-even on the binary value) -> the adjustment's result now rounds half-up explicitly: RND(int((disputed charge - kept excess) x 100 + 0.5 + 0.000001) / 100, 2), the 0.000001 absorbing binary noise below a tenth of a millionth of a cent. Auditor's situation 15,840.00 - 759.375 = 15,080.625 -> 15,080.63 under rule and compute; this world 15,080.565 -> 15,080.57 = gold, unchanged; every factor_sensitivity and the baseline 10,421.13 re-verified by check_compute (COMPUTE OK, no declared computations figure changed). R2-O2 -> the prompt-dispute factor now reads the filing date of the approved dispute (LATEST over damage disputes with status approved), the same dispute the disputed-charge selector and the window test use; its rule sentence and ladder now say 'the approved dispute'. This world has one dispute, approved, filed day 4 -> -50.00 as before. R2-O3 -> refuel_pricing_method's compound condition reads one agreement row, so its 'multi-source' label is removed from this dossier; the task's multi-source factor is consumer_credit_standing_multiplier (card account status and card ledger). R2-O1 concerns task 0's policy and is not seedable (no reinstatement history in the pro schema); left as an observation.

REVISIONS round 4 (re-audit revision_3, item R3-1). Symptom: the proof fields still quoted the edge-skip adjustments 14,938.17 (deductible skipped) and 15,024.76 (refuelling skipped). Root cause: both land on half-cent ties (14,938.175 and 15,024.765); the round-3 N-1 fix moved the adjustment to explicit half-up rounding, so they now round to 14,938.18 and 15,024.77, while the round-3 note checked only the computations block. Change: edge_load_bearing, the problem-tree card's deletion sensitivity and the adjustment's argument_uniqueness_tracing now state 14,938.18 / 15,068.19 / 15,024.77, recomputed with the framework evaluator (real tool replay, the named step skipped, G's current compute): skip deductible 14,938.18, skip accessories 15,068.19, skip refuelling 15,024.77, gold 15,080.57. Every edge still bears weight. The round-3 note's 'no declared figure changed' referred to the computations block only (scored values, factor_sensitivity, baseline_result), which is still exact; the edge-skip figures above were the two that did change. Task 0's edge-skip figures (1,681.37 / 1,157.04) were recomputed the same way and are unchanged (task 0's credit rule states no tie-break and neither figure is a tie).
user_scenario:
You are Imogen Thackeray Pruitt, a homeowner in Nashville who rented a compact track loader from the Ridgeline rental center, store 0412, to regrade her back yard, and towed it home and back with her own truck. You are organised and polite, a little anxious about money, and you like to have things confirmed clearly. When you returned the loader the store found damage to it and put a very large repair charge on your agreement, even though you had paid for the damage protection. You disputed it, and the store manager emailed you on Monday that my dispute on the damage charge was approved. You are calling Customer Care now to get that charge corrected on the agreement; that is the only thing you raise.

You do not know internal reference numbers. When asked how to find your account you give your phone number, 6155550462. To confirm your identity you give the last four of your Social Security number, 6930, and, only if a further detail is requested, your billing ZIP code 37215; if asked, your email is imogen.pruitt@harrowfield.net and your date of birth is 1984-11-02. If asked which rental, you read the agreement number from your receipt: RA-0412-184560. You do not remember the repair figure to the cent and say the agent will see it on the record. If asked about your Ridgeline credit card, you say you have one and the agent can look it up; you do not read out card numbers. If asked how you got the loader home, you say you towed it yourself.

You do not know how Ridgeline works out the correction and you never suggest a figure. If the agent tells you something else from the return has to be put on the agreement before the damage charge can be corrected, you say "okay, if that has to be on the bill too, go ahead" and let the agent handle it, without asking for details. When the agent tells you the corrected amount and hands you the step to accept it, you will accept it yourself, using exactly the agreement, dispute, charge and amount the agent gives you, and then read back what the confirmation shows. If the agent offers instead to post the correction without your acceptance, you say you would rather accept it yourself since it settles your dispute. Once you hear the correction is on the agreement, you thank the agent warmly and end the call without asking for anything else.

edges.condition: On an agreement with damage protection whose inspection found accidental damage, the agreement's ledger carries the damage deductible line computed under the damage deductible rule.
edges.policy_source: The adjustment on an approved damage dispute is fixed only after the agreement carries the damage deductible line owed for the incident.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Protection was taken and the inspection found accidental damage with repair cost 15,840.00, so a deductible line is owed for the incident, yet the ledger carries no damage_deductible line: the store billed the whole repair as damage_repair.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 8 books a damage_deductible line of 284.78; ded_b becomes 284.78 and the protected repair cost falls by that amount.

edges.condition: When the return inspection counted accessories not returned, the agreement's ledger carries the missing-accessory line computed under the missing-accessory rule.
edges.policy_source: No adjustment on an approved damage dispute is booked until the agreement carries the missing-accessory charge owed from the return inspection.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The inspection counted 2 accessories not returned but recorded the outcome as damaged, so no missing-accessory line was triggered; none stands on the ledger.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 10 books a missing_accessory line of 24.75; acc_b becomes 24.75.

edges.condition: When the fuel level at return is below the fuel level at checkout, the agreement's ledger carries the refuelling line computed under the refuelling rule.
edges.policy_source: Before the adjustment on an approved damage dispute is worked out, the agreement must carry the refuelling charge owed for its fuel reading at return.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites are parallel and independent: the deductible reads the inspection, protection flag, time lines, card and dates; the accessory charge reads the inspection, time lines and card; the refuelling reads the fuel and date fields, time lines and card; none reads another's line. Any order of steps 7-12 gives 284.78 / 24.75 / 111.60, the same adjustment 15,080.57 and the same terminal hash, since every row id is a content hash of its own arguments. The adjustment comes last because its rule's three prerequisite sentences wait on all three lines.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 8 leaves ded_b 0.00; the adjustment recomputes to 14,938.18 instead of 15,080.57 and the deductible line is missing.
Skipping step 10 leaves acc_b 0.00; the adjustment recomputes to 15,068.19 and the accessory line is missing.
Skipping step 12 leaves fuel_b 0.00; the adjustment recomputes to 15,024.77 and the refuelling line is missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona speaks only of the approved damage dispute and the protection she bought. It never mentions a deductible, missing accessories, bucket teeth, fuel or refuelling, and never hints that anything must be billed first; its only line about other items is passive consent if the agent says something else has to be on the bill.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: accept_damage_adjustment_c3a91d5f in task_tools.py reads the agreement only to copy customer_id, agreement_number and balance_due, creates the adjustment line and updates balance_due; it never checks for deductible, accessory or refuelling lines and returns no error, so an adjustment accepted first would be written at whatever amount is passed.
